info.name: Hospital FMS - Subsystem Ingestion & Simulation
info.description:
Postman collection for simulating external hospital subsystem transactions into the Hospital Financial Management System (FMS).

Subsystems Simulated:
1. Clinical / BDMS / SPRS: Patient Encounters & Billing Ingestion
2. Supply Chain / PSM / SWS: Vendor Purchase Invoices (3-Way Match)
3. HRMS: Hospital Staff Payroll Register & Statutory Deductions

request.description: Simulates an external clinical encounter discharge bill. Automatically provisions a Patient Account (MRN), computes Senior 20% discount (VAT-exempt), partitions PhilHealth case rates and HMO coverage, and posts the journal entry to the General Ledger.
